description: Defines a class for handling radar axis in a graph plotting library, extending category axis functionality, including methods for calculating axis properties and rendering tick marks.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Radar
classes.description: A class for rendering a radar plot's axis, mapping dataset elements to angles and drawing radial lines with labels.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the axis, always 0.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the axis, equal to the number of labels.

methods.name: _calcDelta
methods.description: Calculates the angular delta between axis labels based on the number of labels.

methods.name: _point
methods.description: Calculates the pixel position (angle in degrees) for a given value.

methods.name: _size
methods.description: Returns the size of the axis, always 0 for radar.

methods.name: setDistanceFromEnd
methods.description: Sets the pixel offset for label placement from the end of radial lines.

methods.name: _drawAxisLines
methods.description: Placeholder for drawing axis lines (empty implementation).

methods.name: _drawTick
methods.description: Draws a tick mark and label at a specified value on the axis.
